title: 第21章 跟电影中演的不一样啊
content_zh:
第21章 跟电影中演的不一样啊-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

顾承安点开第一个记忆视频，是周国胜和妻弟何志平在仓库里拆箱验货的场景。

一箱箱印着中华lOgO的烟堆在角落，旁边码着整齐的飞天茅台纸箱。

视频里周国胜的声音：“这批货包装可以，比上次那批强，上次有个客户差点看出来。”

何志平的声音：“阿龙说换了新模具，防伪码都能扫出来。”

顾承安关掉视频。

近三年流水三百八十万，利润一百六十万。

假烟假酒，买的人轻则花冤枉钱，重则喝出问题进医院。

花了真钱买了一肚子工业酒精勾兑的东西，想想就恶心。

这种钱也赚，也不怕生儿子没py。

他打开通讯录，找到苏楠的号码，拨出。

“喂？”

“苏警官，我，顾承安！”

“嗯，知道是你，什么事？”

“我跟你说个情况，离我住的小区不远有家烟酒店，叫鑫隆烟酒。

我今天进去买水的时候，跟老板聊了聊，感觉他那个中华和茅台的价格不太对，比市场价低不少。

然后我特意看了一下包装，做工确实有点粗糙，防伪标的位置也跟正品有偏差。”

他停了一下，继续说：“我之前送外卖跑烟酒店跑得多，正品假货还是能分出来的。另外，我听说他微讯朋友圈在卖这些，量挺大的，应该不只是零售。”

电话那头沉默了一会，显然在消化这个消息。

苏楠带着职业性的审慎问道：“就凭包装和价格判断？”

“还有一个事。”顾承安语气平静，“我在他店里门口的时候，无意中听到他接了个电话，对面他喊志平，说什么C栋仓库那边你去盯着，下午有一批货到。大浪街道那边的工业区。”

苏楠没说话，但顾承安能听到电话那头笔尖划过纸面的声音。

她在记录。

“你怎么记这么清楚？”

“职业习惯，送外卖嘛，对地址比较敏感。”

苏楠沉吟了几秒：“行，这个信息我记下了。不过这事不归我们重案组管，我转给经侦和市场监管那边，你把店铺的具体地址发我微讯。”

“好。”

挂了电话，顾承安把店铺地址和周国胜的基础外貌特征编辑成文字，发到苏楠的微讯上。

天珠里采集到的详细数据，他不能直接给出去——没法解释来源。

Gu Chengan clicked on the first memory video, which was the scene of Zhou Guosheng and his wife's brother He Zhiping unpacking and inspecting goods in the warehouse.

Boxes of cigarettes with the Chinese logo printed on them were piled in the corner, with neatly stacked Feitian Moutai cartons next to them.

Zhou Guosheng's voice in the video said: "This batch of goods is packaged well and is better than the last batch. A customer almost noticed it last time."

He Zhiping's voice: "Aaron said that with the new mold, the security code can be scanned out."

Gu Chengan turned off the video.

In the past three years, the turnover was 3.8 million yuan and the profit was 1.6 million yuan.

People who buy fake cigarettes and fake alcohol will at least spend a lot of money, or at worst, they will have drinking problems and end up in the hospital.

I spent real money to buy something mixed with industrial alcohol, which makes me sick just thinking about it.

I can make this kind of money, and I don’t have to worry about giving birth to a son.

He opened his address book, found Su Nan's number, and dialed it.

"Hello?"

"Officer Su, I, Gu Chengan!"

"Well, I know it's you, what's the matter?"

"Let me tell you something. There is a tobacco shop not far from the community where I live, called Xinlong Cigarette and Liquor.

When I went in to buy water today, I chatted with the boss and felt that the price of his Zhonghua and Moutai was not quite right. It was much lower than the market price.

Then I took a special look at the packaging. The workmanship was indeed a bit rough, and the position of the anti-counterfeiting label was also different from the original product."

He paused for a moment and continued: "I used to deliver food and travel to cigarette hotels a lot, and I can still distinguish genuine products from fake ones. In addition, I heard that his WeChat Moments are selling these. The quantity is quite large, so it should not be just for retail."

There was silence on the other end of the phone for a while, obviously digesting the news.

Su Nan asked with professional prudence: "Just based on the packaging and price?"

"One more thing." Gu Chengan said in a calm tone, "When I was at the door of his store, I overheard him answering the phone. He called Zhiping on the other side and said that you should keep an eye on the warehouse in Building C. A batch of goods will arrive in the afternoon. The industrial area over Dalang Street."

Su Nan said nothing, but Gu Chengan could hear the sound of the pen tip scratching the paper on the other end of the phone.

She's recording.

"How do you remember it so clearly?"

"Professional habits, like delivering food, I'm quite sensitive to addresses."

Su Nan pondered for a few seconds: "Okay, I have written down this information. However, this matter is not under the control of our serious crime team. I will transfer it to the economic investigation and market supervision. You can send me the specific address of the store on WeChat."

"Okay."

After hanging up the phone, Gu Chengan edited the store address and Zhou Guosheng's basic physical characteristics into text and sent it to Su Nan's WeChat.

He couldn't directly give out the detailed data collected in the Dzi Bead - he couldn't explain the source.
